# DAPR State Store Component -- Local Development
# =============================================================
# Redis-backed state store for actor state and command status tracking.
# actorStateStore: "true" enables DAPR actor state management.
#
# keyPrefix: "none" keeps state keys un-prefixed so they are shared verbatim across the
# eventstore / tenants / folders app-ids (preserves the Folders state-key layout that the
# previous in-code component established -- do not change without a state-migration story).
#
# Component Scoping (Folders topology, Epic 9): the EventStore command gateway owns aggregate
# actor state; Tenants writes projections; the Folders services read/write folder state; the Memories
# search-index server (Story 9.2) reuses this shared state store. There is no eventstore-admin app-id
# in the gateway-only Folders topology.
apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: statestore
spec:
  type: state.redis
  version: v1
  metadata:
    # DAPR does not support the `{env:VAR|default}` template form, so an unset
    # REDIS_HOST left the literal string as the hostname and daprd failed with
    # "no such host". `dapr init` provisions Redis at 127.0.0.1:53296 with no password.
    - name: redisHost
      value: "127.0.0.1:53296"
    - name: redisPassword
      value: ""
    - name: actorStateStore
      value: "true"
    - name: keyPrefix
      value: "ordinary-proof-99e34285df2392cc"
scopes:
  - eventstore-99e34285df2392cc
  - tenants-99e34285df2392cc
  - folders-99e34285df2392cc
  - folders-workers-99e34285df2392cc
  - folders-ui-99e34285df2392cc
  - memories-99e34285df2392cc

  - folders-workers-proof-a-99e34285df2392cc
  - folders-workers-proof-b-99e34285df2392cc

# DAPR Resiliency Policies -- Local Development
# ================================================================
# Retry / timeout / circuit-breaker policies for the Folders topology. Targets reference the
# eventstore app and the shared statestore / pubsub components (Epic 9). A Resiliency CRD is not
# scoped per app-id (no `scopes:` field); each sidecar that loads it applies the matching targets.
apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Resiliency
metadata:
  name: resiliency
spec:
  policies:
    retries:
      defaultRetry:
        policy: constant
        duration: 1s
        maxRetries: 3
      # Pub/sub outbound: publisher -> sidecar -> broker
      pubsubRetryOutbound:
        policy: exponential
        maxInterval: 10s
        maxRetries: 3
      # Pub/sub inbound: broker -> sidecar -> subscriber app
      pubsubRetryInbound:
        policy: exponential
        maxInterval: 30s
        maxRetries: 10
    timeouts:
      # Each timeout is a named duration string (DAPR rejects nested objects here).
      daprSidecar: 5s
      # Pub/sub outbound: prevent hung sidecar->broker calls
      pubsubTimeout: 10s
      # Pub/sub inbound: allow more time for subscriber processing
      subscriberTimeout: 30s
    circuitBreakers:
      defaultBreaker:
        maxRequests: 1
        interval: 10s
        timeout: 30s
        trip: consecutiveFailures > 3
      # Pub/sub circuit breaker for prolonged broker outages
      pubsubBreaker:
        maxRequests: 1
        interval: 10s
        timeout: 30s
        trip: consecutiveFailures > 5
  targets:
    apps:
      eventstore-99e34285df2392cc:
        retry: defaultRetry
        timeout: daprSidecar
        circuitBreaker: defaultBreaker
    # These policies AUGMENT built-in pub/sub component retries.
    # Effective retry count = component built-in retries x resiliency retries.
    components:
      pubsub:
        outbound:
          retry: pubsubRetryOutbound
          timeout: pubsubTimeout
          circuitBreaker: pubsubBreaker
        inbound:
          retry: pubsubRetryInbound
          timeout: subscriberTimeout
      # State store resiliency: retry and circuit breaker for state persistence.
      # Without this target, transient Redis failures would fail without retry.
      statestore:
        retry: defaultRetry
        timeout: daprSidecar
        circuitBreaker: defaultBreaker

# WARNING: Local development only.
# Production must use deny-by-default Dapr access control with mTLS.
apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Configuration
metadata:
  name: accesscontrol
spec:
  accessControl:
    defaultAction: allow
    trustDomain: "public"
    policies:
      - appId: eventstore-99e34285df2392cc
        defaultAction: allow
        trustDomain: "public"
        namespace: "folders-durability-99e34285df2392cc"
      - appId: tenants-99e34285df2392cc
        defaultAction: allow
        trustDomain: "public"
        namespace: "folders-durability-99e34285df2392cc"
      - appId: folders-99e34285df2392cc
        defaultAction: allow
        trustDomain: "public"
        namespace: "folders-durability-99e34285df2392cc"
      - appId: folders-workers-99e34285df2392cc
        defaultAction: allow
        trustDomain: "public"
        namespace: "folders-durability-99e34285df2392cc"
      - appId: memories-99e34285df2392cc
        defaultAction: allow
        trustDomain: "public"
        namespace: "folders-durability-99e34285df2392cc"
